summary: Bug fix validation — Helmet 'expects a string as child of title' error on /citadelle/blog/[slug] pages. Fix confirmed working: Helmet block removed from CitadelleBlogPost.js, useSeoMeta hook handles SEO via direct DOM manipulation. All 4 requested test scenarios passed.
critical_code_review_comments: CitadelleBlog.js (list page) still uses Helmet block — this is intentional and does NOT reproduce the bug since it only contains plain string children (no conditional && expressions). No action needed.

In Test 3 (in-page navigation via related article click), the page showed a loading skeleton for ~1-2s before data loaded — this is normal API latency, not a bug. Direct load (Test 4) confirmed full render.
